procedures.text: For the intake queue, first response must occur within 4 hours. Count a breach only when elapsed time exceeds this threshold.
For the intake queue, resolution must occur within 48 hours. Count a breach only when elapsed time exceeds this threshold.
For the intake queue, first response must occur within 2 hours. Count a breach only when elapsed time exceeds this threshold.
For the intake queue, resolution must occur within 24 hours. Count a breach only when elapsed time exceeds this threshold.
For the review queue, first response must occur within 8 hours. Count a breach only when elapsed time exceeds this threshold.
For the review queue, resolution must occur within 72 hours. Count a breach only when elapsed time exceeds this threshold.
For the review queue, first response must occur within 4 hours. Count a breach only when elapsed time exceeds this threshold.
For the review queue, resolution must occur within 48 hours. Count a breach only when elapsed time exceeds this threshold.
The intake queue distinguishes first-response breaches from resolution breaches. Counts use the service date in UTC. A case can breach both measures; do not add their counts.
